boundary_constraints.free_rule: Exclude modes from FixBoundaryR/FixBoundaryZ where abs(m) <= 2 and abs(n) <= 2, except the R major-radius mode [0, 0, 0].
boundary_constraints.fixed_rule: Pass all remaining modes to FixBoundaryR/FixBoundaryZ, so modes with abs(m) > 2 or abs(n) > 2 are fixed. Also pass R mode [0, 0, 0] to FixBoundaryR as DESC tutorial regularization.
